key.name: mode
key.summary: Operating mode

key.name: category-count
key.summary: Number of active ToDo categories (1..7)

key.name: category-names
key.summary: Names for each ToDo category

key.name: category-colors
key.summary: Hex colors for each ToDo category

key.name: show-priority-icons
key.summary: Show priority badges on tasks

key.name: confirm-delete
key.summary: Ask for confirmation before deleting archived tasks

key.name: todo-jira-link
key.summary: Show a button on each ToDo task to link it to a Jira issue/subtask

key.name: main-width
key.summary: Main application window width

key.name: main-height
key.summary: Main application window height

key.name: popup-width
key.summary: Tray popup window width (parametrizable)

key.name: popup-height
key.summary: Tray popup window height (parametrizable)

key.name: popup-scale
key.summary: UI scale (%) applied inside the tray popup window

key.name: popup-autohide
key.summary: Close the tray popup automatically when it loses focus
key.description: Makes the popup behave like a momentary panel (e.g. the GNOME calendar): it closes as soon as you click outside it.

key.name: popup-frameless
key.summary: Show the tray popup without a title bar (widget look)

key.name: run-in-background
key.summary: Keep running in the background when the window is closed
key.description: When enabled, closing the window from the dock hides it to the tray instead of quitting. Quit from the tray icon's right-click menu.

key.name: show-tray-icon
key.summary: Show a StatusNotifierItem icon in the top bar

key.name: start-hidden
key.summary: Start with no window shown (background only)

key.name: jira-site
key.summary: Jira Cloud site, e.g. https://your-company.atlassian.net

key.name: jira-email
key.summary: Jira account email (username for API token auth)

key.name: jira-token
key.summary: Jira API token (NOT your password)

key.name: jira-jql
key.default: 'assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY priority DESC, updated DESC'
key.summary: JQL query for the issues to display

key.name: jira-refresh-minutes
key.summary: Auto-refresh interval in minutes (0 = manual only)

key.name: jira-max-results
key.summary: Maximum number of issues to fetch per call

key.name: jira-category-count
key.summary: Number of Jira categories (tabs)

key.name: jira-category-names
key.summary: Display name of each Jira category

key.name: jira-category-colors
key.summary: Hex color of each Jira category

key.name: jira-category-text-colors
key.summary: "white" or "black" text color of each Jira category swatch

key.name: jira-category-filter-fields
key.summary: Field each Jira category filters on: statusCategory/issuetype/status/priority/empty

key.name: jira-category-filter-values
key.summary: Value to match for each Jira category (use ';' for OR)

key.name: jira-status-names
key.summary: Status names whose chip color is overridden

key.name: jira-status-colors
key.summary: Hex color for each overridden status name

key.name: jira-debug
key.summary: Collect Jira fetch/parse debug traces

key.name: gh-token
key.summary: GitHub Personal Access Token

key.name: gh-owner
key.summary: GitHub login of the project owner (user or organization)

key.name: gh-owner-type
key.summary: "user" or "organization"

key.name: gh-project-number
key.summary: Project (V2) number as shown in the URL .../projects/N

key.name: gh-status-field
key.summary: Name of the single-select field used as Status

key.name: gh-include-closed
key.summary: Include closed issues / merged PRs in the fetch

key.name: gh-refresh-minutes
key.summary: Auto-refresh interval in minutes (0 = manual only)

key.name: gh-max-results
key.summary: Maximum number of project items to fetch per call

key.name: gh-category-count
key.summary: Number of GitHub Projects categories (tabs)

key.name: gh-category-names
key.summary: Display name of each GitHub Projects category

key.name: gh-category-colors
key.summary: Hex color of each GitHub Projects category

key.name: gh-category-text-colors
key.summary: "white" or "black" text color of each GitHub category swatch

key.name: gh-category-filter-fields
key.summary: Field each GitHub category filters on: status/type/state/repo/empty

key.name: gh-category-filter-values
key.summary: Value to match for each GitHub category (use ';' for OR)

key.name: gh-debug
key.summary: Collect GitHub fetch/parse debug traces

key.name: notion-api-token
key.summary: Notion internal integration token (secret_… / ntn_…)

key.name: notion-parent-page-id
key.summary: ID of the Notion page under which the ToDo database is created

key.name: notion-database-id
key.summary: ID of the Notion database the ToDo tasks sync into

key.name: notion-sync-on-open
key.summary: Sync the ToDo list with Notion when the app / popup opens

key.name: notion-refresh-minutes
key.summary: Notion auto-sync interval in minutes (0 = manual only)
